replication.target_description: Relationship between object edibility (edible versus non-edible objects) and positive valence ratings in the high-calorie condition. High-calorie food is specified, but non-edible objects could mean office tools or balls; the source treats them as separate categories rather than a pooled non-edible contrast. The office comparison cannot substitute for an unidentified non-edible comparison.

n.sample_role: Candidate abstract count: 27 participants; target-test analytic inclusion unresolved.
n.exclusions: Excerpt reports 14.2 % erroneous trials, 3.3 % early movements and 2.5 SD outlier correction (1.83 % onset, 2.53 % contact, 2.57 % collection); one additional session cancelled. No N derived from these percentages or df.
